title: MAGE: Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence for Transferable Multimodal Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal graphs integrate textual and visual attributes with relational structures, providing a rich representation of complex real-world data. To enable the broad applicability and reuse of graph models, it is crucial for models trained on source graphs to generalize to unseen graph domains. However, this is challenging because cross-modal interactions among neighbors and the neighboring information needed for prediction can vary across target nodes and graph domains. This gives rise to two key challenges: adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion, which captures and integrates cross-modal interactions among neighbors to accommodate variations across nodes and domains; and target-specific evidence selection, which identifies the neighboring textual and visual information needed for each target node to support LLM-based prediction. translated_title: MAGE：面向可迁移多模态图学习的元路径自适应图证据
translated_abstract: 多模态图将文本和视觉属性与关系结构相融合，为复杂的现实世界数据提供了丰富的表示。为了实现图模型的广泛适用性和可复用性，在源图上训练的模型能否泛化到未见过的图域至关重要。然而，这极具挑战性，因为邻居之间的跨模态交互以及预测所需的邻居信息可能因目标节点和图域的不同而变化。这带来了两个关键挑战：自适应跨模态邻域融合，即捕获并整合邻居之间的跨模态交互，以适应节点和域之间的变化；以及面向特定目标的证据选择，即为每个目标节点识别所需的邻居文本和视觉信息，以支持基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测。针对这些挑战，我们提出了MAGE（元路径自适应图证据提示）框架
tldr: 提出MAGE框架，通过元路径自适应图证据提示，解决了可迁移多模态图学习中的自适应跨模态邻域融合与特定目标证据选择两大关键挑战，使模型能够泛化到未见过的图域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MAGE, a meta-path adaptive graph evidence prompting framework that tackles adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion and target-specific evidence selection to enable transferable multimodal graph learning across unseen graph domains.
